meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

Rechecked one-JSON-per-chat, actor scopes and no fabricated evidence contract; health does not add an agent tool or migrate data.

commerce.review_note: ProductService and checkout business logic are unchanged. Catalogue module docs now describe the read-only projection that shares current pricing/visibility. Admin products accepts a selected existing ID without saving; exact browser checks retain original field content rather than rewriting its whitespace.

content.review_note: Reviewed original SeoService and BlogController override paths plus resolved local/persistent image contracts. Canonical/OG/organization defaults now use configured APP_URL, valid explicit overrides remain, bad URL schemes/local missing images fall back safely, and product schema follows in_stock/active and resolved price. Six regressions cover host/request forms, overrides/noindex, real image paths, stock/slug encoding and inline JSON-LD safety.

foundation.review_note: Inspected existing AdminController auth, PublicController shop gate, front-controller allowlist and configured origin. New GET routes extend the current PHP architecture; operational failures are 503 not a fabricated empty feed. DatabaseService, connection configuration and schema remain unchanged. No claim of Google authorization or MCP transport completion.

interface.review_note: Compared the new native owner menu/table/stages and existing product-edit selection with durable admin guidance. Four owner/guest desktop/mobile/no-JS browser cases and two public feed parity cases passed. Screenshots show reachable controls and no horizontal overflow; approval/connection states stay explicitly unverified and no account/checkout writes occur.

mail.review_note: Mail/Smtp sources are unchanged. Shared backend skill runtime requirement note does not alter queue claims/retries or inbox evidence. Existing email guide and atomic accepted/uncertain semantics remain authoritative; no email execution in this feature.

media.review_note: Media storage/delete sources are unchanged. Shared architecture and admin skill now describe private System Health without exposing paths or modifying files; existing media verification/permissions contracts remain unchanged.

operator-help.review_note: Compared catalogue operator guidance with the fixed MerchantFeedService, actual public/admin route wiring and selected-record editor path. The guide distinguishes feed output, Google processing and YouTube eligibility, and adds only real correction/navigation links. Shared ProductService remains authoritative and no private agent prompt or database mutation is introduced.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed service/XML/CLI/UI against ProductService offer and visibility behavior plus current primary Google product-source and invited-creator docs. Verified explicit identifiers only, valid URL/image checks, safe XML, unknown external approval and no credential/account actions. Public browser samples match real prices/images; local missing media is not labelled a production defect.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed native CLI dispatch and structured contract against the pinned WordPress shared-core skill and Shopify CLI reference. Check/schema/feed reuse one PHP service; no shell/SQL tool is exposed to runtime agents. Added explicit sales-channel source dependencies and current README discovery; issue/status stays in GitHub.
